# BUILDING AND OPERATING WORLD-CLASS DATA CENTERS FOR YOUR DIGITAL FUTURE.

CyrusOne designs, builds, and operates industry-leading data centers globally for the world's
leading enterprises, delivering unmatched reliability, security, and innovation to power your
transformation.

**Ready to explore what we can achieve together?**

[Scale]

### Build-to-Suit

We partner with organizations to create purpose-built data center solutions that align precisely
with business objectives. Our collaborative approach combines innovative design with proven
development practices to ensure rapid, reliable deployment across global markets.

[ Learn More ][75]
[Cloud]

CyrusOne leads in hyperscale data center solutions, delivering the performance, availability, and
scalability required by the world's largest companies. Our facilities support massive computational
demands while enabling rapid deployment and expansion.

[ Learn More ][76]

demands of artificial intelligence applications. This advanced platform delivers the power density,
cooling efficiency, and scalability required for next-generation AI workloads.

Our enterprise colocation solutions provide secure, connected environments for business-critical
infrastructure. CyrusOne's facilities offer flexible scaling options, robust connectivity, and
comprehensive support services to meet our customers’ evolving technology requirements.

Our dedication to excellence drives everything we do – from environmental stewardship to customer

### Sustainability

We're pioneering sustainable data center solutions with our commitment to become climate neutral by
2030. Our comprehensive approach focuses on climate action, water conservation, biodiversity
protection, and circular economy practices.

[Learn More][80]
[Sustainability]

### Health & Safety

Safety stands at the forefront of every operation through our "Safe by Design" philosophy and
proactive risk management. Our comprehensive EHS programs protect everyone who enters our facilities
while exceeding industry standards.

[Learn More][81]
[Health and Safety]

### Compliance

We maintain the highest levels of compliance across global operations, going beyond industry
requirements with rigorous certifications and standards. Our dedicated teams continuously monitor
and enhance our adherence to evolving global regulations.

[Learn More][82]
[Compliance]

### Communities

We create lasting positive impact in every community where we operate through economic investment,
workforce development, and environmental initiatives. Our teams actively engage in local
partnerships and volunteer programs to strengthen the regions we serve.

[Learn More][83]

# The future doesn't need another cloud.It needs every cloud, connected

From powering enterprise AI to protecting data sovereignty, your clouds, data and AI workloads must
work as one—privately, at scale and free from lock-in.

[Explore Connectivity Solutions][57][Talk to Equinix][58]

## Enterprise AI is distributed everywhere.That's why you need Equinix.

The global infrastructure that connects your clouds, your data and your AI. Everywhere it runs.

[Explore Distributed AI][59][Talk to an expert][60]
AI demands more than a single cloud

Enterprise AI spans clouds, platforms and data. Equinix connects them so AI can run faster, better
and smarter.

AI runs where data lives

Equinix data centers unite clouds, networks and SaaS in one global ecosystem. Putting your AI closer
to the data and the compute it needs.

Sovereignty is non-negotiable

Keep data where regulations demand while scaling across clouds, partners and markets. All from one
unified platform.

Intelligence can't wait

The unequaled proximity of Equinix data centers put AI within milliseconds of the data and compute
it needs to scale.

# Airedale by Modine

## The Critical Cooling Specialists

At Airedale by Modine, we believe that air conditioning has a critical role to play in an
ever-changing world. We also passionately believe that air conditioning manufacturers must play a
responsible role in an era where sustainability is key to the preservation of our planet.

Whether you need to maintain productive and healthy working environments for people or optimised
operating envelopes for critical equipment in data centers and other industries, Airedale by Modine
delivers a tailored solution based on world-class products, industry-leading design, intelligent
software, and unrivalled end-to-end customer support.

# Airedale by Modine

## The Critical Cooling Specialists

At Airedale by Modine, we believe that air conditioning has a critical role to play in an
ever-changing world. We also passionately believe that air conditioning manufacturers must play a
responsible role in an era where sustainability is key to the preservation of our planet.

Whether you need to maintain productive and healthy working environments for people or optimised
operating envelopes for critical equipment in data centers and other industries, Airedale by Modine
delivers a tailored solution based on world-class products, industry-leading design, intelligent
software, and unrivalled end-to-end customer support.

## Services

###  Endpoint Device Solutions

Comprehensive supply and support for laptops, desktops, printers, and accessories to ensure seamless
operations for corporates and PSUs. Our solutions include procurement, installation, and ongoing
maintenance to keep your endpoint devices running smoothly.

[Read More][15]

### Networking Infrastructure

Robust networking solutions tailored for corporate and public sector environments. We design,
implement, and manage network infrastructures that enhance connectivity, security, and performance,
ensuring your organization stays connected and productive.

[Read More][16]

### Data Center Solutions

State-of-the-art data center setups designed to meet the demands of modern businesses. Our services
cover everything from planning and design to implementation and management, ensuring your data
center is secure, scalable, and efficient.

[Read More][17]

### Surveillance Systems

Advanced surveillance setups for organizations to enhance security and monitoring. Our solutions
include high-definition cameras, access control systems, and integrated monitoring platforms to
safeguard your premises and assets.

[Read More][18]

###  Office Automation

Streamlined office automation solutions to boost efficiency and productivity. From smart office
devices to automated workflows, we provide the tools and technologies that transform your workplace
into a modern, efficient environment.

[Read More][19]

At Arrow Abroad, we specialize in delivering innovative IT solutions tailored to meet your business
needs. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing top-notch services that drive efficiency,
enhance productivity, and foster growth. Explore our range of services designed to empower your
business:

your business grows. Our flexible architecture supports cloud integration and performance
optimization, ensuring that your infrastructure can accommodate future needs without compromising
security or efficiency. Arrow Abroad helps you future-proof your data center, providing solutions
that adapt to dynamic business requirements".

## Frequently asked questions

What is latency and what constitutes good latency?

**Latency**, often referred to as ping, is the duration for data to travel from the source to the
destination and back. The results of this test represent the median round trip time (RTT) latency to
AWS storage endpoints, with lower RTT indicating superior performance.

**What constitutes good latency?** Good latency varies by application type:
* **Real-time applications** (e.g., gaming, video conferencing): latency below 50 ms is ideal.
* **Interactive applications** (e.g., web browsing, online trading): latency between 50 ms and
  100 ms is usually acceptable.
* **Non-interactive applications** (e.g., file transfers, backups): latency above 100 ms may be
  acceptable.

These guidelines may vary depending on specific application needs and user expectations.

DOBE Computing has been answering one persistent industry challenge: how to deploy data center
infrastructure faster, simpler, and more cost-effectively.

Our all-in-one packaged data centers are designed for exactly that. Connect power. Go live.
Deployment that once took months now takes weeks.

The sealed "Cooling Zone" isolates your servers from external contaminants—dust, heat,
humidity—while precision cooling maintains optimal operating temperatures. Eco-friendly by design,
supporting your sustainability initiatives without added cost.

Customizable configurations include fire suppression, redundant cooling, remote monitoring, and
energy recovery systems. Enterprise-grade functionality. Streamlined delivery.

15 years of expertise. Hundreds of deployments. Let's build yours.

Since 2010, DOBE Computing has been a leading manufacturer of modular data centers, containerized
data centers, and edge data center solutions. Our turnkey packaged data centers feature
plug-and-play deployment, sealed Cooling Zone technology, precision cooling systems, and
eco-friendly design. Customizable options include fire suppression, redundant cooling units, remote
monitoring, and energy recovery ventilators. Enterprise-grade data center infrastructure with
streamlined delivery. Made in Korea.

center solutions are designed for plug-and-play deployment. Simply plug in, power on, and you're
done. No complex installation required. Enterprise-grade data center infrastructure made simple.

**DOBE Computing - Modular Data Center Solutions Video Introduction**
This official video showcases DOBE Computing's comprehensive data center infrastructure solutions,
including eZDatacenter, eZOutdoor, Micro Data Center, Cooling Rack, Smart Rack, and ESS/BESS energy
storage systems. Since 2010, Made in Korea.

Our turnkey modular data centers feature plug-and-play deployment, high-efficiency precision
cooling, and robust environmental protection for both indoor and outdoor installations. Whether you
need an Edge Data Center, Containerized Data Center, or a custom Micro Data Center solution, DOBE
Computing delivers enterprise-grade infrastructure with streamlined delivery.

Key solutions featured in this video:
* eZDatacenter - Prefabricated Modular Data Center
* eZOutdoor - Outdoor Telecom Enclosure & Cabinet
* Micro Data Center - Compact All-in-One Solution
* Cooling Rack - Precision Cooling Server Cabinet
* Smart Rack - Intelligent Rack with Integrated Cooling
* ESS/BESS - Containerized Energy Storage Systems

DOBE Computing serves global partners across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle
East. Our modular data center solutions support rapid deployment for AI infrastructure, edge
computing, telecommunications, military applications, and enterprise IT environments. Contact us at
info@dobe.co.kr to become a global partner.

decades of tradition in front of the region’s business and alumni networks.

# Infrastructure Without Compromise

Reliable data center & cloud solutions.

[ Get Started ][215]

## Purpose-Built Data Centers for Today's Enterprise Demands

### Enhanced Security

Our facilities have 24×7 CCTV monitoring, dual authentication entry, and individually secured
cabinets for added security.

### Compliance

With SSAE 18 SOC 2 certification, and PCI SAQ-D compliance, our facilities give you peace of mind.

### Uptime Assurance

Nationwide SLAs and N+1 or greater facilities, backed by generators, ensure protection for your
critical infrastructure.

### The Inner Circle

DartPoints’ carrier-neutrals facilities provide an ecosystem of choice for connectivity to networks
and clouds empowering your growth.

## Find The Nearest Dartpoints Data Center

DartPoints strategically places data centers in mid-sized markets, addressing diverse and unique
regional needs and fostering economic growth.

Proximity to end users ensures low latency and reliable disaster recovery, reinforcing DartPoints’
role in providing colocation and cloud services to support business growth and resilience in these
markets.

# The Most Connected Data Centers in Finland

Are you looking for new space for your servers and telecommunications equipment? Do you need a
backup or edge data center or a secure place to run backups and implement Disaster Recovery plans?

[ Learn about the features
][15]

## Why choose Digita's Data Center?

### The best possible connectivity

By locating your business-critical hardware environment in Digita’s secure and reliable data
centers, you will benefit from the best possible connectivity to the networks of most
telecommunications operators.
[ Read more ][16]

### Easy connection

The best network is not based on bandwidth alone. Digita’s Helsinki Pasila region is located right
in the heart of Pasila’s media hub, where also the FICIX Helsinki IXP (Internet Exchange Point) is
located. This enables easy connection and peering with the network operators or the partners you
need.
[ Read more ][17]

### Climate neutral high-performance and high secure data centers

Digita Data Centers' electricity is Nordic wind power, and the cooling system is efficiently
integrated into the district cooling network.
[ Read more ][18]

## Customer Reference: Restolution, Alpit and Digita

### A successful partnership model for modern infrastructure

Restolution is a Nordic technology company providing a cloud-based platform for the hospitality
sector. Its solution brings together all key components of the restaurant ecosystem, including
sales, payments, kitchen operations and analytics, into one integrated service.

Thousands of restaurants, hotels, cafés, and entertainment venues across the Nordics rely on
Restolution to support their daily operations. **More than €200 million in sales transactions are
processed through the platform every month.**

Digita Data Centers delivered a new data center and infrastructure solution for Restolution in
partnership with Alpit Nordic. The solution is based on a three-party model in which Digita is
responsible for the data center and infrastructure services, Alpit provides the technical
implementation, and Restolution receives the complete solution through a single coordinated
partnership.

[ Read more
][19]

## Why Digita Data Centers and Finland?

### 5 reasons why Finland is a good environment and country for data centers

Data centers are being rapidly established in Europe to meet the ever-increasing demand for data,
including the rise of artificial intelligence. Location scouts are now working actively, and there
are not many locations in Europe as good as Finland, where cost-effective energy, existing space and
plots, natural cooling and high-quality, high-speed telecommunications provide equally ideal
conditions for launch services.

There are currently more than 50 data centers in Finland, and the number is growing all the time.
FDCA—The Finnish Data Center Association last year estimated that around 2GW of new data center
capacity will be started in Finland in the near future. It is also important to remember that
existing capacity can be utilized, making Finland an attractive market in this regard as well.

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

# Building for everyone

We build data centers that power essential technology and services as we invest in community
development and lead the industry in data security and sustainability.

[oklahoma-pry-steven-lozano-faith-lanham-2025-1108-rt.webp]

[Link to Youtube Video][27] (visible only when JS is disabled)

We build world-class data centers, providing the essential infrastructure that enables businesses,
governments, and individuals to connect with each other, championing an inclusive and sustainable
future for all.

## Cultivating growth in
## our data center communities

Play Pause

Data centers are the engine for the transition to the digital economy. They link people to a variety
of industries, from supermarkets and retailers to schools and nonprofits.

### Accelerating economies

Together, we are driving increased economic growth, supporting local innovation, and creating career
opportunities within each of our data center communities.

[View our progress][28]

### Workforce development

As a responsible neighbor, we are partnering with, and investing in, our data center communities to
provide sustained support through workforce development, educational opportunities, and other
beneficial initiatives. With inclusive access to AI and digital opportunities, we can better prepare
communities to thrive for generations.

[See how we invest in our neighbors][29]
Play Pause

Google is proud to operate multiple data centers in Northern Virginia — a global hub of the digital
economy — and to support community organizations there that are enabling people and changing lives.
We've collaborated with two inspiring local organizations in the region, Global Inheritance and
Mobile Hope, to introduce more young women to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) and
to combat youth homelessness.

Play Pause

In Hamina, Finland, where Google has a data center, we are working with city-owned energy provider
Haminan Energia to kick off our first offsite heat recovery project to reduce our environmental
footprint, as well as help warm homes and businesses in this historic port city.

### Expanding access

Each day, we build for a tomorrow where everyone can benefit. We strengthen community connections by
investing in local initiatives like sustainability programs for young children. We enhance digital
integration with projects like rural internet connectivity. And we spark economic opportunities by
providing high-paying jobs through our infrastructure projects.

[See how we build for tomorrow][30]

## Building toward a more
## sustainable future

### We harness technology to spur positive environmental change

We aspire to build the most efficient computing systems, while caring for water resources and making
energy grids strong. We work with communities to ensure we responsibly power the products and
services our communities rely on.

[Discover how we’re operating sustainably][31]
[A team of solar panel installers work together on placing a panel into place on a solar farm in
Fredericia, Denmark, in collaboration with our data center.]

The Rødby Fjord solar project adds clean energy to the grid that powers our data center in
Fredericia, Denmark.

## Ensuring your data is
## safer and more secure

[A technician troubleshoots an issue between a row of servers in our The Dalles, Oregon, data
center.]

Denise inspects a central processing unit (CPU) at one of our data centers.

### We design our data centers with security in mind

Security is part of our data centers’ DNA. We custom build servers exclusively for our data centers,
and our industry-leading security team works 24/7 around the globe, making our facilities one of the
safest places for your data to live.

### Meet some of the people who collaborate with Google to benefit their communities.
* [A recent Google Skilled Trades and Readiness Program graduate sits outside on the curb, smiling.]
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  View more
  
  ## Aurora Rodriguez
  ## Northern Virginia, USA
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  Aurora Rodriguez has already built the foundation for a strong career. She credits her mom for
  giving her the strength and the gumption to begin pursuing her goals and dreams early. Her mom
  came to the United States from Honduras right after 9/11, and has worked the same job for the same
  salary since she began, working days and nights and taking the bus everywhere. This inspired
  Aurora to aim higher. She finished high school online so she could start working full time her
  sophomore year. “Everything I do is so she can have a better life and retirement.”
  
  Aurora always knew she wanted to work in the trades and began in welding. However, it became a
  challenge physically and financially to continue that work. She moved into logistical roles, yet a
  career in the trades still called to Aurora.
  
  That’s when she heard about Google’s Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program in Construction
  at Northern Virginia Community College. She completed the program in 2024, which has led to more
  project management opportunities at her job and a desire to go back to school and earn a four-year
  degree. Aurora’s mom is surely beaming with pride. “I remember the tough times, that no matter
  what, my mom made sure I pushed through.”
  [AURORA.png]
  [Aurora 02]
  
  ## “I came from a logistical background from Amazon to UPS stores. I was trying to prepare going
  ## back to school...and then I came upon the STAR Program.”
  
  ## “The STAR Program is making a difference in communities. It is giving opportunities to people
  ## who probably felt stuck just like I did.”
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  STAR Program Graduate in Construction
  [Aurora-1.jpg]
* [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  Marco Ynema
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  View more
  
  ## Marco Ynema
  ## Eemshaven, Netherlands
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  Marco Ynema, site lead at our Eemshaven data center in the Netherlands, is focused on growth,
  whether it’s for himself in his career, or in his proficiency as a musician and audio engineer, or
  in helping others.
  
  Born and raised in the Netherlands, Marco’s background is in computer science and audio
  engineering. He had ambitions for a career in music. Looking for stability as his family grew, he
  opted to pursue computer science and IT roles instead.
  
  Marco arrived at Google in 2005, contracting as a data center technician, but he was quickly hired
  a year later, moving to the U.S. to work with teams on site reliability engineering and software
  engineering. When he heard Google was building the Eemshaven data center, he shifted back to
  working within operations in the Netherlands. “The best place to raise my two daughters,” he says.
  
  As a site lead, he's observed Google’s evolution in the community, becoming more involved in
  outreach, including building school curriculum. Marco was involved in launching an apprenticeship
  program for local secondary institutions, hosting students at the Eemshaven data center, which led
  to full-time roles for some.
  
  In addition to seeing Google grow our commitments to the community, he enjoys helping people grow.
  “What I love most is to work together with my colleagues to build something and grow what we're
  working on and improve.”
  
  And music still plays a leading role in Marco’s life. He played in multiple bands over the years.
  Marco even built a recording studio in his backyard, ceaselessly focused on growing his talent.
  [Profile picture of Googler Marco Ynema in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  ## “As we grow our presence, we see more interactions with the local community because we are part
  ## of the community. I also see it as our obligation to actually ensure that we are not only
  ## reaping the benefits from being here in this country, but by contributing by increasing
  ## infrastructure and creating opportunities and jobs and other things.”
  
  Marco Ynema
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near a canal with boats floating by in Eemshaven, Netherlands]

# Building for everyone

We build data centers that power essential technology and services as we invest in community
development and lead the industry in data security and sustainability.

[oklahoma-pry-steven-lozano-faith-lanham-2025-1108-rt.webp]

[Link to Youtube Video][27] (visible only when JS is disabled)

We build world-class data centers, providing the essential infrastructure that enables businesses,
governments, and individuals to connect with each other, championing an inclusive and sustainable
future for all.

## Cultivating growth in
## our data center communities

Play Pause

Data centers are the engine for the transition to the digital economy. They link people to a variety
of industries, from supermarkets and retailers to schools and nonprofits.

### Accelerating economies

Together, we are driving increased economic growth, supporting local innovation, and creating career
opportunities within each of our data center communities.

[View our progress][28]

### Workforce development

As a responsible neighbor, we are partnering with, and investing in, our data center communities to
provide sustained support through workforce development, educational opportunities, and other
beneficial initiatives. With inclusive access to AI and digital opportunities, we can better prepare
communities to thrive for generations.

[See how we invest in our neighbors][29]
Play Pause

Google is proud to operate multiple data centers in Northern Virginia — a global hub of the digital
economy — and to support community organizations there that are enabling people and changing lives.
We've collaborated with two inspiring local organizations in the region, Global Inheritance and
Mobile Hope, to introduce more young women to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) and
to combat youth homelessness.

Play Pause

In Hamina, Finland, where Google has a data center, we are working with city-owned energy provider
Haminan Energia to kick off our first offsite heat recovery project to reduce our environmental
footprint, as well as help warm homes and businesses in this historic port city.

### Expanding access

Each day, we build for a tomorrow where everyone can benefit. We strengthen community connections by
investing in local initiatives like sustainability programs for young children. We enhance digital
integration with projects like rural internet connectivity. And we spark economic opportunities by
providing high-paying jobs through our infrastructure projects.

[See how we build for tomorrow][30]

## Building toward a more
## sustainable future

### We harness technology to spur positive environmental change

We aspire to build the most efficient computing systems, while caring for water resources and making
energy grids strong. We work with communities to ensure we responsibly power the products and
services our communities rely on.

[Discover how we’re operating sustainably][31]
[A team of solar panel installers work together on placing a panel into place on a solar farm in
Fredericia, Denmark, in collaboration with our data center.]

The Rødby Fjord solar project adds clean energy to the grid that powers our data center in
Fredericia, Denmark.

## Ensuring your data is
## safer and more secure

[A technician troubleshoots an issue between a row of servers in our The Dalles, Oregon, data
center.]

Denise inspects a central processing unit (CPU) at one of our data centers.

### We design our data centers with security in mind

Security is part of our data centers’ DNA. We custom build servers exclusively for our data centers,
and our industry-leading security team works 24/7 around the globe, making our facilities one of the
safest places for your data to live.

### Meet some of the people who collaborate with Google to benefit their communities.
* [A recent Google Skilled Trades and Readiness Program graduate sits outside on the curb, smiling.]
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  View more
  
  ## Aurora Rodriguez
  ## Northern Virginia, USA
  
  Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program Graduate in Construction
  
  Aurora Rodriguez has already built the foundation for a strong career. She credits her mom for
  giving her the strength and the gumption to begin pursuing her goals and dreams early. Her mom
  came to the United States from Honduras right after 9/11, and has worked the same job for the same
  salary since she began, working days and nights and taking the bus everywhere. This inspired
  Aurora to aim higher. She finished high school online so she could start working full time her
  sophomore year. “Everything I do is so she can have a better life and retirement.”
  
  Aurora always knew she wanted to work in the trades and began in welding. However, it became a
  challenge physically and financially to continue that work. She moved into logistical roles, yet a
  career in the trades still called to Aurora.
  
  That’s when she heard about Google’s Skilled Trades and Readiness (STAR) Program in Construction
  at Northern Virginia Community College. She completed the program in 2024, which has led to more
  project management opportunities at her job and a desire to go back to school and earn a four-year
  degree. Aurora’s mom is surely beaming with pride. “I remember the tough times, that no matter
  what, my mom made sure I pushed through.”
  [AURORA.png]
  [Aurora 02]
  
  ## “I came from a logistical background from Amazon to UPS stores. I was trying to prepare going
  ## back to school...and then I came upon the STAR Program.”
  
  ## “The STAR Program is making a difference in communities. It is giving opportunities to people
  ## who probably felt stuck just like I did.”
  
  Aurora Rodriguez
  STAR Program Graduate in Construction
  [Aurora-1.jpg]
* [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  Marco Ynema
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  View more
  
  ## Marco Ynema
  ## Eemshaven, Netherlands
  
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center
  
  Marco Ynema, site lead at our Eemshaven data center in the Netherlands, is focused on growth,
  whether it’s for himself in his career, or in his proficiency as a musician and audio engineer, or
  in helping others.
  
  Born and raised in the Netherlands, Marco’s background is in computer science and audio
  engineering. He had ambitions for a career in music. Looking for stability as his family grew, he
  opted to pursue computer science and IT roles instead.
  
  Marco arrived at Google in 2005, contracting as a data center technician, but he was quickly hired
  a year later, moving to the U.S. to work with teams on site reliability engineering and software
  engineering. When he heard Google was building the Eemshaven data center, he shifted back to
  working within operations in the Netherlands. “The best place to raise my two daughters,” he says.
  
  As a site lead, he's observed Google’s evolution in the community, becoming more involved in
  outreach, including building school curriculum. Marco was involved in launching an apprenticeship
  program for local secondary institutions, hosting students at the Eemshaven data center, which led
  to full-time roles for some.
  
  In addition to seeing Google grow our commitments to the community, he enjoys helping people grow.
  “What I love most is to work together with my colleagues to build something and grow what we're
  working on and improve.”
  
  And music still plays a leading role in Marco’s life. He played in multiple bands over the years.
  Marco even built a recording studio in his backyard, ceaselessly focused on growing his talent.
  [Profile picture of Googler Marco Ynema in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  [Googler Marco Ynema stands near many bikes in Eemshaven, Netherlands]
  
  ## “As we grow our presence, we see more interactions with the local community because we are part
  ## of the community. I also see it as our obligation to actually ensure that we are not only
  ## reaping the benefits from being here in this country, but by contributing by increasing
  ## infrastructure and creating opportunities and jobs and other things.”
  
  Marco Ynema
  Googler, Site Lead at Eemshaven Data Center

# Building the
# Data Centers of
# the Future

In a world where data centers drive every aspect of modern life, ECL engineered a
community-integrated, flex-grid, modular AI data center solution. We deliver autonomous power that
is fully sustainable minimal environmental impact.

[build your site][10]
[ECL Data Center]
Key benefits

### We are Building and Operating the best Flex-Grid Modular Data Centers Globally

[Sustainability]

###### Sustainability

Flex-Grid power from Grid through Natural Gas to HYdrogen, no Diesel generators, minimal to zero
emission, zero water use, PUE under 1.1

[ECL Block Architecture]

###### Modularity

The ECL Block design was created to maximize Modularity. This fundamental 1 to 2 MW building block
allows ECL to deliver a consistent experience in all locations. This applies to any type of location
and use cases brown and greenfield properties.

[icon of customer TCO]

###### Best Customer TCO

The ECL novel solution improves the customer’s overall TCO by reducing the cost to build and
opeatare and improving by that the power and MRR cost.

[Data Center]

###### Built to Order

ECL builds a disaggregated site according to the customer’s specification one MW at a time. The
customer defines any rack criteria, set power requirement per individual rack, the availability and
redundancy modes, and the data center internal temperature.

[Fast Turn Around Time Icon]

###### Time to Delivery

With the Flex-Grid ECL offers industry-leading time to delivery from Purchase Order to IT-ready site
including on-demand network and server integration services.

[Green Power Generation System Icon]

###### Availability and Efficiency

ECL provides an Exceedingly efficient cooling system with up to 150KW per rack, and superior space
utilization (kW per sqft). Additionally, On site power generation with integrated BESS and, minimal
transmission loss, eliminates the need for a UPS system

[learn more][11]
Testimonials

### In Our Partners
### Words

[Dean Nelson]

"The ECL solution solves the economic, ecological and community challenges of building data centers.
Lower costs with high efficiency to operators, drastic carbon reduction in line with the iMasons
Climate Accord, and zero consumption of local resources. I’m excited for ECL to launch the world's
first off-grid data centers with primary power from hydrogen."

Dean Nelson
[Peter Gross]

The ECL design is one of the most innovative concepts ever developed, that will significantly
enhance the next generation data center efficiency, sustainability, flexibility and reliability.

Peter Gross.
Sustainability

### Mega Data Center In a Small Package

[Block of Green Power]

##### Green Power

ECL is the first to pioneer a continuous Hydrogen power generation system allowing for
zero-emissions environment in data centers independent of the traditional power grid. utilizing the
hydrogen fuel cell.

[Water free Data Center]

##### Water free
##### data centre

The ECL data center is water based cooling with have zero community water usage, it also creates
extra water as part of the Hydrogen power generation process that can be delivered back to the
community.

[Modular with high Space Utilization]

##### Modular with high
##### space utilization

The ECL Block is a 1 to 1.2W modular building block that can be scaled in each location up to as
many MW’s as needed. ECL’s state of the art cooling, purpose-built building and rack infrastructure
design gives you the maximum amount of compute per square foot.

[Block of Breed Management Software]

##### Best of breed
##### management software

ECL has developed a next generation platform giving unsurpassed visibility and transparency into the
status of the data center environment. This is a critical component of ECL’s
Data-Center-as-a-Service offering. Features include: Real Time Alerting and Visualization, Trending,
Predictive Modeling, Site Optimization, Capacity Planning, and PUE.

# ProgressiveProjects

At EDC, we are proud to lead some of the most ambitious and technically advanced projects in
Ireland, the United Kingdom, and internationally, driven by innovation, sustainability, and a
commitment to cutting-edge design.

[Our Projects][10]

# ProgressiveSolutions

EDC is your Global Partner for Progressive MEP Delivery with offices in Cork, Dublin, Galway,
Midwest, London and Istanbul.

[About EDC][11]

# ProgressiveCareers

If you’re passionate about innovation, sustainability, and delivering excellence for top-tier
clients, EDC offers the platform for you to advance your career and make a lasting impact.

[Careers at EDC][12]

## Your Global Partner For Progressive MEP Delivery

EDC is an international engineering consultancy specialising in Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing
(MEP) design, BIM, Energy and Sustainability services. With an extensive project portfolio delivered
over the past 22 years, we combine global expertise with local knowledge to deliver innovative,
sustainable and cost-efficient solutions.

Operating from offices in Ireland, the UK and Istanbul, our multidisciplinary team partners with
clients across a diverse range of sectors to shape smarter, more resilient buildings and
infrastructure. Known for our forward-thinking approach and commitment to excellence, we ensure
quality, coordination and value from concept to completion.

[About EDC][13]
[aerial photography of city]

## Progressive Solutions

At EDC, we provide progressive MEP, BIM, Energy and Sustainability solutions for a wide range of
industries and clients, delivering high-performance, energy-efficient designs that meet the needs of
modern buildings and infrastructure. Here at EDC, we believe progressive thinking drives better
outcomes. Our solutions are rooted in innovation, sustainability, and practical expertise - giving
our clients greater confidence, clarity, and long-term value at every stage of the project.

[Our Services][14]

## Progressive Projects

We’re proud to lead some of the most ambitious and technically complex engineering projects across
Ireland, the UK, and internationally. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainable building
practices, and advanced MEP & BIM design, we help deliver high-value construction projects for
progressive businesses. Our multi-sector expertise ensures we consistently support clients in
shaping the future of the built environment with reliable, forward-thinking solutions.

[View Projects][15]

## Progressive Careers

**What makes EDC stand out as an employer of choice?**

At EDC, we’re more than an engineering consultancy - we’re a global team working with leading
multinational clients on high-profile projects. If you’re passionate about sustainable design,
innovation, and delivering real impact, EDC provides the platform to grow your career while working
on some of the most exciting projects in MEP design, BIM, and energy engineering.

We invest in our people through continuous development, mentorship, and clear progression pathways.
Our collaborative culture values initiative, supports learning, and recognises achievement at every
level. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step, you’ll be part of a
forward-thinking team helping shape the future of the built environment.

[Careers at EDC][16]

## Why Partner With EDC?

We’ve listened to our clients and understand what matters most. Quality design, collaboration, cost
& risk control and projects on time. That’s why our approach is simple: deliver a value-driven
service that aligns with your priorities and our principles.

#### Collaboration

#### Progressive Solutions

At EDC, we are proud to lead some of the most ambitious and technically advanced projects in
Ireland, the United Kingdom, and internationally, driven by innovation, sustainability, and a
commitment to cutting-edge design.

[Our Projects][10]

# ProgressiveSolutions

EDC is your Global Partner for Progressive MEP Delivery with offices in Cork, Dublin, Galway,
Midwest, London and Istanbul.

[About EDC][11]

# ProgressiveCareers

If you’re passionate about innovation, sustainability, and delivering excellence for top-tier
clients, EDC offers the platform for you to advance your career and make a lasting impact.

[Careers at EDC][12]

## Your Global Partner For Progressive MEP Delivery

EDC is an international engineering consultancy specialising in Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing
(MEP) design, BIM, Energy and Sustainability services. With an extensive project portfolio delivered
over the past 22 years, we combine global expertise with local knowledge to deliver innovative,
sustainable and cost-efficient solutions.

Operating from offices in Ireland, the UK and Istanbul, our multidisciplinary team partners with
clients across a diverse range of sectors to shape smarter, more resilient buildings and
infrastructure. Known for our forward-thinking approach and commitment to excellence, we ensure
quality, coordination and value from concept to completion.

[About EDC][13]
[aerial photography of city]

## Progressive Solutions

At EDC, we provide progressive MEP, BIM, Energy and Sustainability solutions for a wide range of
industries and clients, delivering high-performance, energy-efficient designs that meet the needs of
modern buildings and infrastructure. Here at EDC, we believe progressive thinking drives better
outcomes. Our solutions are rooted in innovation, sustainability, and practical expertise - giving
our clients greater confidence, clarity, and long-term value at every stage of the project.

[Our Services][14]

## Progressive Projects

We’re proud to lead some of the most ambitious and technically complex engineering projects across
Ireland, the UK, and internationally. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainable building
practices, and advanced MEP & BIM design, we help deliver high-value construction projects for
progressive businesses. Our multi-sector expertise ensures we consistently support clients in
shaping the future of the built environment with reliable, forward-thinking solutions.

[View Projects][15]

## Progressive Careers

**What makes EDC stand out as an employer of choice?**

At EDC, we’re more than an engineering consultancy - we’re a global team working with leading
multinational clients on high-profile projects. If you’re passionate about sustainable design,
innovation, and delivering real impact, EDC provides the platform to grow your career while working
on some of the most exciting projects in MEP design, BIM, and energy engineering.

We invest in our people through continuous development, mentorship, and clear progression pathways.
Our collaborative culture values initiative, supports learning, and recognises achievement at every
level. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step, you’ll be part of a
forward-thinking team helping shape the future of the built environment.

[Careers at EDC][16]

We’ve listened to our clients and understand what matters most. Quality design, collaboration, cost
& risk control and projects on time. That’s why our approach is simple: deliver a value-driven
service that aligns with your priorities and our principles.

[Sound Equipment]

## Our Process

We deliver unparalleled system solutions that meet and exceed your requirements throughout its life
cycle.

##### [magnifying glass]We analyze

Electronic Design Company will analyze the project based on the client’s needs, budget and vision.
* On-site System Evaluations
* Acoustic Modeling
* EASE Modeling
* Signal Flow Diagrams
* Client Needs Development

##### [light bulb]We Design

Our design group is accustomed to working in all phases of a system’s design, coordinating
operations with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors and end users.
* Design Customized Solutions
* Consideration of Operational Simplicity
* Incorporate Consulting and Analysis Results

##### [gear]We integrate

Our technicians and installers have received factory training in the programming and installation of
the products that we integrate into systems every day.
* Perform physical installation, testing, tuning and commissioning of equipment
* Develop and execute training customized to client systems and user groups
* Provide complete system submittals and documentation
* Detailed system drawings and programming files are developed and available for the client to allow
  for efficient system support

##### [Gear in a cycle]We maintain

Fully customized support plans with our proven Evergreen System Management program ensure system
uptime and longevity.
* Remote system monitoring and management
* Highly experienced and continuously trained technicians
* 24/7 support is available to ensure critical systems are operational
* Customized system assessments and preventative maintenance plans

## Prioritize Performance

Request an introduction to learn more about designing, integrating and maintaining the critical
communication systems that keep your world connected.

[Aerial view of a data center campus at dusk][Aerial view of a data center campus at dusk]

## Built to deliver for hyperscalers

EdgeCore develops and operates high-density, single-tenant data centers  exclusively for the world’s
largest  cloud and AI companies. With data center industry veterans at the helm and ample financial
backing, we take a disciplined approach to securing land, power, and community support before
construction begins. Safety is no secret. Execution is our cornerstone.

Data center campuses built for the AI revolution. Strategically located, future-focused for density
and scale with safety, sustainability, and the surrounding community top of mind.

2.27+ GW
Data Center Portfolio

With $7.4 billion in capital currently committed and over $16 billion in planned investment,
EdgeCore has the financial backing to fund development without constraints.

$16.1B
Planned Investment

At EdgeCore, we put our customers first—always. With pragmatic designs that enable repeatable builds
and scalable operations, we strive to meet every commitment we make and exceed expectations every
day.

100%
Customer Milestones Met
[Abstract geometric sculpture against a blue sky][Abstract geometric sculpture against a blue sky]

Designed for density isn’t just EdgeCore’s tagline, it’s the foundation upon which our unique
business model is built. Our focus is singular: build high-density, single tenant data centers with
an absolute certainty of execution. Safety for our employees, partners and customers is top of mind
at all times; and our facilities and programs are designed to meet key performance specifications,
sustainability objectives and community expectations.

Why EdgeCore
][37]

EdgeCore's six U.S. markets were chosen for their combination of available power, land suitable for
300+ MW campuses, and proximity to hyperscale demand. With data center supply constraints tightening
exponentially, EdgeCore’s near-term power and construction delivery dates are some of the earliest
in the industry.

## PURPOSE-BUILT, NEXT-GEN

# HYPER EDGE DATA CENTERS

[Tier IV Data Center icon]

### Tier IV Data Centers
### Engineered and
### Built In-House

HostDime facilities are designed and operated by our in-house engineering team, with focus on
performance, redundancy, and reliability. Purpose-built to Tier IV standards, each site provides
fully redundant power and cooling with no single points of failure. Designed to support maintenance,
scaling, and continuous operation without downtime risk.

[Global Locations icon]

### Global Locations
### Infrastructure in
### Underserved Markets

HostDime operates in high-growth regional markets underserved by hyperscale providers — Orlando,
Guadalajara, João Pessoa, and beyond. Each facility functions as a regional infrastructure anchor.
Deliver low-latency access to regional users and direct paths into major network corridors without
Tier 1 congestion.

[Interconnection icon]

### Interconnection
### Where Your Infrastructure
### Meets the Network

Deploy where carriers, ISPs, and Internet Exchanges already operate. HostDime facilities provide
direct access to Tier 1 providers including Cogent, Lumen, Zayo, and Verizon, with IXP availability
in select markets. The result is shorter network paths, simplified architecture, and redundancy
built into the facility itself.

## About VNCOOL

Welcome to learn about our company

VNCOOL Technology — also marketed as VISION COOL — builds thermal and power infrastructure for data
centers and mission-critical environments. Our portfolio spans precision air conditioning,
free-cooling systems, liquid cooling for high-density AI workloads, modular data centers, UPS,
batteries, and DCIM monitoring — all designed, tested, and manufactured in-house by a team with over
two decades in the industry. Three R&D centers in Shenzhen, Xi'an, and Zhongshan collaborate across
the full portfolio, while our Zhongshan manufacturing base turns that engineering into product at
scale

Liquid Cooling

Direct to Chip liquid cooling technology for AI training, HPC clusters, and GPU pods. Heat exchange
from 20 kW to 2,400 kW. From single-rack pilots and air-to-liquid retrofits to in-row CDUs and
room-level systems for next-gen cooling solutions
[Get your products][29]

Precision Cooling

Direct expansion and chilled-water precision cooling, from 3 kW to 200 kW. Covering every
white-space position — telecom shelters, edge cabinets, modular data centers, and full server halls
— with rear-door heat exchange available for high-density racks on a unified engineering platform
[Get your products][30]

Free Cooling

Dual engine and three-mode free cooling system built around VNCOOL's in-house refrigerant pump.
Cooling capacity from 12 kW to 660 kW, switching automatically between compressor, hybrid, and full
free-cooling as wet-bulb drops — capturing every economization hour the climate offers by self R&D
refrigerant pump
[ Get Your products ][31]

Modular DC

Factory-integrated prefabricated data centers deployable in hours, not months. From all-in-one edge
cabinets for 1–7 racks to dual-row halls for 10+ racks, up to ISO containers rated −40 to +55 °C
with 360 kW IT load for outdoor and field deployment
[ Get Your products ][32]

UPS

Online double-conversion UPS for IT and industrial loads, spanning 1 kVA to 4,800 kVA.
High-frequency rack, tower, and modular hot-swap systems for data center white space; low-frequency
isolation-transformer systems for refineries, mining, rail, and hospital plant rooms

## About VNCOOL

Welcome to learn about our company

VNCOOL Technology — also marketed as VISION COOL — builds thermal and power infrastructure for data
centers and mission-critical environments. Our portfolio spans precision air conditioning,
free-cooling systems, liquid cooling for high-density AI workloads, modular data centers, UPS,
batteries, and DCIM monitoring — all designed, tested, and manufactured in-house by a team with over
two decades in the industry. Three R&D centers in Shenzhen, Xi'an, and Zhongshan collaborate across
the full portfolio, while our Zhongshan manufacturing base turns that engineering into product at

Liquid Cooling

Direct to Chip liquid cooling technology for AI training, HPC clusters, and GPU pods. Heat exchange
from 20 kW to 2,400 kW. From single-rack pilots and air-to-liquid retrofits to in-row CDUs and
room-level systems for next-gen cooling solutions
[Get your products][29]
[列间&房间级CDU]

Precision Cooling

Direct expansion and chilled-water precision cooling, from 3 kW to 200 kW. Covering every
white-space position — telecom shelters, edge cabinets, modular data centers, and full server halls
— with rear-door heat exchange available for high-density racks on a unified engineering platform
[Get your products][30]

Free Cooling

Dual engine and three-mode free cooling system built around VNCOOL's in-house refrigerant pump.
Cooling capacity from 12 kW to 660 kW, switching automatically between compressor, hybrid, and full
free-cooling as wet-bulb drops — capturing every economization hour the climate offers by self R&D
refrigerant pump
[ Get Your products ][31]

Modular DC

Factory-integrated prefabricated data centers deployable in hours, not months. From all-in-one edge
cabinets for 1–7 racks to dual-row halls for 10+ racks, up to ISO containers rated −40 to +55 °C
with 360 kW IT load for outdoor and field deployment
[ Get Your products ][32]

UPS

Online double-conversion UPS for IT and industrial loads, spanning 1 kVA to 4,800 kVA.
High-frequency rack, tower, and modular hot-swap systems for data center white space; low-frequency
isolation-transformer systems for refineries, mining, rail, and hospital plant rooms

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

To power digital transformation, there must be a more robust, secure and autonomous enterprise
network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising
bandwidth demands, a more complex threat landscape and the analytics needed to power AIOps tools.
Marvell has a networking and compute portfolio that delivers performance, intelligence, security and
telemetry needed for the modern enterprise network.

consumer and enterprise applications that promise to transform entire industries and serve the
world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

## Marvell Enables AI Infrastructure

To realize the promise of AI, hyperscalers are undertaking one of the largest infrastructure
buildouts in history—and they rely on Marvell as a critical AI infrastructure partner. Marvell
designs custom silicon tailored for any application and offers the industry’s most comprehensive
portfolio of interconnects and network switch products. From custom compute to rack, row, data
center, campus and multi-campus connectivity, Marvell enables the world’s most advanced AI
infrastructure.

[Learn More][120]
[Play video]

### Markets
* DATA CENTER
* ENTERPRISE
* CARRIER

Marvell Data Center Solutions
[Marvell Data Center Solutions]
DATA CENTER

### Scaling AI

As the number and size of AI models explodes, data center infrastructure requirements are evolving
rapidly, forcing innovation across the compute, interconnect and switching domains of accelerated
infrastructure. Marvell custom silicon and system-level connectivity platforms enable hyperscalers
to design and implement their own unique AI data-center architectures optimized for their own unique
applications.

[Learn More][121]
Marvell Enterprise Solutions
[Marvell Enterprise Solutions]
ENTERPRISE

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

To power digital transformation, there must be a more robust, secure and autonomous enterprise
network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising
bandwidth demands, a more complex threat landscape and the analytics needed to power AIOps tools.
Marvell has a networking and compute portfolio that delivers performance, intelligence, security and
telemetry needed for the modern enterprise network.

[Learn More][122]
Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions
[Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions]
CARRIER

### Connecting the World with 5G Network Silicon

With increased capabilities, performance and edge intelligence, 5G enables a plethora of new
consumer and enterprise applications that promise to transform entire industries and serve the
world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Janta Power Brings Rapidly Deployable Clean Energy to Fan Festivals and Beyond

][54]

**Janta Power**, a leading developer of patented three-dimensional solar tower energy systems,
announced a milestone for rapidly deployable infrastructure in support of one of the world’s largest
sporting events. At Fan Festival sites in Dallas and Houston, Janta’s innovative solar towers
generated power quietly and concurrently, demonstrating a new model for energy installations that
simplify sourcing logistics and align with compressed operational timelines.

[solar]The Dallas installation at Fair Park consists of four JP5K solar towers with integrated 28
kWh battery energy storage systems (BESS) and served as a temporary power source for the duration of
the Fan Festival. The East Downtown Houston tower and associated BESS served the Fan Festival and
will remain as a permanent fixture, purchased to benefit the community and provide power for public
amenities over a 25-year life span.

Both tower systems were deployed and fully operational within days, generating up to 275 KWh per day
to support event infrastructure for thousands of visitors throughout the Fan Festivals. In addition,
the towers feature a small footprint and visually appealing, fully functional body panels with
graphic designs representing the energetic spirit of the host cities.

"The World Cup is more than a sporting event – it's a proving ground for the future of energy
infrastructure," said Mohammed Njie, Founder and CEO of Janta Power. "By providing clean, quiet
power in days instead of months, we're demonstrating that renewable energy can be delivered where
it's needed most, without sacrificing speed, reliability, or performance. Whether it's powering a
global event, an AI data center, an airport, or a community, our mission is the same: to make clean,
affordable, and reliable energy quickly available wherever people need it.”

“Reliable power is a constant logistical consideration across festivals and large-scale events, so
solutions that simplify deployment can have a real operational impact,” said Skye Fabrizio,
Sustainability Manager at C3 Presents. “Janta’s towers were installed quickly, required minimal
space compared to standard solar installations, and provided quiet, reliable power directly on-site.
After seeing the technology in action, I see meaningful potential for its use across a much wider
range of live events and temporary installations."

Janta’s vertical solar towers are designed to generate approximately 50% more energy than
traditional flat-panel systems while using one-third of the land area, overcoming energy-density and
siting constraints that limit conventional solar. Each tower’s stacked vertical design and
integrated tracking system capture both low-angle morning and evening light, producing a dual-peak
power curve that better aligns with real energy demand.

The Fan Festival installations build on Janta’s growing commercial applications. Pilot programs are
underway with major global airports, including [Munich International
Airport][55], [Aena][56] (operator of over 70 airports worldwide), and [Dallas–Fort Worth
International Airport][57] (DFW), as part of the [Airports for Innovation][58] (A4I) initiative. The
momentum reflects a broader shift already under way: as power-hungry industries from AI to
telecommunications race to secure more capacity, the ability to stand up clean, quiet power sources
on limited square footage is a competitive advantage.

[ [Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells] ][60]
Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells

][61]

**Factorial Energy Inc.** (Nasdaq: FAC) ("Factorial"), a leading American solid-state battery
innovator, announced its first commercial drone battery order. The order marks Factorial’s entry
into commercial aerospace applications.

The order marks Factorial’s first commercial order in the aerospace sector and follows successful
battery integration and drone flight testing. Factorial will supply high-energy-density
lithium-metal cells for integration into battery packs by a U.S.-based pack integrator, creating a
battery cell and pack supply chain designed to support demanding drone applications.

Factorial provides a foundation built to scale across the full breadth of physical AI — drones,
autonomous aviation, space, defense, and robotics — and to power a generation of autonomous machines
that must carry both their own intelligence and their own energy.

Unlike artificial intelligence operating inside centralized data centers, physical AI is embedded in
machines that operate in the real world. Drones, autonomous aircraft, mobile robots, spacecraft,
defense platforms, and other intelligent systems must carry both their own computing capability and
their own energy. These applications require more than batteries that simply store energy: they
require systems that deliver high power, manage heat, operate safely near people and sensitive
electronics, and maintain reliability under demanding environmental and mission conditions.

“We are thrilled about this commercial order from the aerospace sector, on the heels of our
successful integration and drone flight test that demonstrated a more than 30% increase in flight
range,” said Siyu Huang, CEO of Factorial. “It’s a validation that the same rigorous qualification
standards behind last year’s 1,200 km record drive and our first vehicle production program now
extend into an entirely new field. In only six months, we designed a new product, built integration
partnerships on three continents, completed flight testing, and secured a first purchase order. That
is the strategy working as designed. We are committed to building the foundational energy layer that
will underpin the next era of mobility and artificial intelligence. Humanity deserves better
batteries, and delivering them is our mission.”

As batteries become critical infrastructure for autonomous and intelligent systems over the next
decade, Factorial is positioning its technology to serve a broad and rapidly expanding marketplace.
According to a [March 2026 report][62] by the strategy consulting business unit of
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), the global Physical AI market is projected to reach approximately €430
billion by 2030, with significant upside potential as systems that operate in the real, physical
world continue to scale and mature.

far from users, even small delays can impact revenue, user experience, and overall efficiency. An
edge data center solves this by placing compute power closer to where data is generated.

Processing happens on site, eliminating delays caused by distant centralized systems. This is
critical for real time applications, AI inference, and live analytics.

Continuity
100%

Local compute continues to run even if network connectivity is disrupted. Your operations remain
active without dependency on constant internet availability.

Sovereignty
Locked

Sensitive data stays within your environment, helping meet regulatory and compliance requirements
without compromising performance.

Steel sandwich construction, weatherproof ratings, and thermal insulation make NPOD systems
deployable anywhere, not just inside climate-controlled server rooms.

waiting for facility upgrades.

Everything you need to know about NPOD's modular data center solutions, edge infrastructure, and

An AI data center is a specialized facility designed to support artificial intelligence workloads
such as machine learning, data analytics, and real-time processing. It uses high performance
hardware like GPUs, advanced cooling systems, and scalable power infrastructure to handle intensive
computing demands. Unlike traditional data centers, an AI infrastructure platform is optimized for
speed, efficiency, and large scale data processing, enabling businesses to run AI applications
faster, more reliably, and closer to where data is generated.
2. Does India Have AI data centers?
Yes, India has AI data centers, and they are growing quickly with strong investment from both Indian
and global companies. These data centers are built to handle AI and machine learning workloads using
powerful GPUs, advanced cooling systems, and scalable power. Major cities like Mumbai, Noida, and
Bangalore are key locations for these facilities. With the rapid growth of digital services, cloud
computing, and 5G, India is becoming an important hub for AI-ready infrastructure and modern
computing needs.
3. What are the 4 types of data center?
The 4 types of data centers are:
**a) Enterprise data center** Owned and operated by a single organization. They offer full control
over infrastructure, security, performance, and compliance requirements.
**b) Colocation data center** Businesses rent space in a shared facility, while the provider manages
power, cooling, security, and overall data center infrastructure operations.

scalability, flexibility, cost efficiency, and global accessibility for businesses.
**d) Edge data center** Located closer to users, enabling low latency and real-time data processing
for modern applications like AI, IoT, and 5G networks.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about NPOD's modular data center solutions, edge infrastructure, and

1. What is the AI data center?
An AI data center is a specialized facility designed to support artificial intelligence workloads
such as machine learning, data analytics, and real-time processing. It uses high performance
hardware like GPUs, advanced cooling systems, and scalable power infrastructure to handle intensive
computing demands. Unlike traditional data centers, an AI infrastructure platform is optimized for
speed, efficiency, and large scale data processing, enabling businesses to run AI applications
faster, more reliably, and closer to where data is generated.
2. Does India Have AI data centers?
Yes, India has AI data centers, and they are growing quickly with strong investment from both Indian
and global companies. These data centers are built to handle AI and machine learning workloads using
powerful GPUs, advanced cooling systems, and scalable power. Major cities like Mumbai, Noida, and
Bangalore are key locations for these facilities. With the rapid growth of digital services, cloud
computing, and 5G, India is becoming an important hub for AI-ready infrastructure and modern
computing needs.
3. What are the 4 types of data center?
The 4 types of data centers are:
**a) Enterprise data center** Owned and operated by a single organization. They offer full control
over infrastructure, security, performance, and compliance requirements.
**b) Colocation data center** Businesses rent space in a shared facility, while the provider manages
power, cooling, security, and overall data center infrastructure operations.
**c) Cloud data center** Provides on-demand computing resources over the internet with high
scalability, flexibility, cost efficiency, and global accessibility for businesses.
**d) Edge data center** Located closer to users, enabling low latency and real-time data processing
for modern applications like AI, IoT, and 5G networks.

AI-powered support systems at Instagram demonstrated how attackers can exploit vulnerabilities in
account recovery workflows to gain unauthorized access to social media accounts.

## YOUR DATA STARTS HERE.

## ®

SBA Edge provides edge computing infrastructure for a wide range of clients through our
telecommunication tower sites and regional data centers.

## Our main differences as a company

And that’s why so many clients turn to SBA Edge.

##### Reliability

99.999% uptime SLA, Tier-compliant infrastructure and 24/7 monitoring ensure uninterrupted,
mission-critical operations and 29,000 POP´s.

##### Flexibility

Customizable racks, private cages and scalable solutions meet any client need, from single cabinets
to full enterprise builds.

##### Connectivity

Multi-site, high-density, cloud and fiber-ready connections enable efficient routing and low-latency
edge performance.

[ I WANT TO TALK TO AN EXPERT ][53]

## Data Centers at our Tower Locations

SBA Edge is collaborating with partners to establish a new paradigm for edge computing
infrastructure, providing local sites with the requisite power, connectivity and redundancy. Our
modular data centers are built to the highest standards, supporting distributed and mobile workloads
through colocation cabinets supported by redundant power and cooling systems. We also provide
telecom shelters with backup power. These compact units are deployed at tower sites and designed to
integrate seamlessly with wireless operators.

SBA Edge is a subsidiary of SBA Communications, a publicly traded company listed on NASDAQ (SBAC)
and part of the S&P 500 with over 30 years of experience in digital infrastructure.

## Where We Operate

**For more information on SBA Edge, select our operations in the United States or Brazil**

### UNITED STATES

With over 17,000 wireless towers and multiple regional data centers, our U.S. portfolio offers ample
opportunity to support local computing requirements.

### BRAZIL

With over 12,000 wireless towers and a São Paulo data center, our Brazilian operations have
tremendous reach and a range of data center solutions.

## REGIONAL DATA CENTERS

## Our regional multi-megawatt data centers support global, national, regional and local customers,
## including enterprise, cloud, telecommunications and government entities. We provide secure,
## highly-redundant facilities with bandwidth and interconnect available to all.

## YOUR DATA STARTS HERE.

## ®

SBA Edge provides edge computing infrastructure for a wide range of clients through our
telecommunication tower sites and regional data centers.

## Our main differences as a company

And that’s why so many clients turn to SBA Edge.

##### Reliability

99.999% uptime SLA, Tier-compliant infrastructure and 24/7 monitoring ensure uninterrupted,
mission-critical operations and 29,000 POP´s.

##### Flexibility

Customizable racks, private cages and scalable solutions meet any client need, from single cabinets
to full enterprise builds.

##### Connectivity

Multi-site, high-density, cloud and fiber-ready connections enable efficient routing and low-latency
edge performance.

[ I WANT TO TALK TO AN EXPERT ][53]

## Data Centers at our Tower Locations

SBA Edge is collaborating with partners to establish a new paradigm for edge computing
infrastructure, providing local sites with the requisite power, connectivity and redundancy. Our
modular data centers are built to the highest standards, supporting distributed and mobile workloads
through colocation cabinets supported by redundant power and cooling systems. We also provide
telecom shelters with backup power. These compact units are deployed at tower sites and designed to
integrate seamlessly with wireless operators.

SBA Edge is a subsidiary of SBA Communications, a publicly traded company listed on NASDAQ (SBAC)
and part of the S&P 500 with over 30 years of experience in digital infrastructure.

## Where We Operate

**For more information on SBA Edge, select our operations in the United States or Brazil**

### UNITED STATES

With over 17,000 wireless towers and multiple regional data centers, our U.S. portfolio offers ample
opportunity to support local computing requirements.

### BRAZIL

With over 12,000 wireless towers and a São Paulo data center, our Brazilian operations have
tremendous reach and a range of data center solutions.

## REGIONAL DATA CENTERS

## Our regional multi-megawatt data centers support global, national, regional and local customers,
## including enterprise, cloud, telecommunications and government entities. We provide secure,
## highly-redundant facilities with bandwidth and interconnect available to all.

## Our philosophy

We want to help you improve your lease, not line our own pockets. Our goal is to help you however we
can, and if we can’t, we won’t pitch you services you don’t need or buy your lease. We’ll never
encourage you to do something you’re uncomfortable with. Our team is made up of industry experts who
aim to help you however they can. We are the cell tower lease experts who work **only for you**, not
the cell phone or tower companies, and our goal is to get you the best cell tower lease or cell
tower lease buyout possible. We also offer counsel for a full year after we evaluate your lease, so
you’re never left out in the cold.

With over 15,000 cell tower lease rate datapoints in our lease database, we can provide you with the
most reliable information available. Because we have over 20 years of experience, we can provide you
with the best, most reliable data, so you know what to expect. We also offer flexible payment terms,
so we can meet your specific needs. Unlike some of our competitors, we won’t take a percentage of
your lease. Instead, we charge a fixed, flat rate or work on a contingency basis.

least hassle.

## WHY DO AI WORLD-FIRSTS HAPPEN AT SWITCH?

For over 20 years, Switch has been designing, building and operating the world’s highest density
data centers. The first SUPERNAP^{®} data center, designed in 2006 by Rob Roy, was an air & liquid
cooling hybrid design built decades before the AI revolution. Rob Roy’s new EVO AI Factories design
has now taken extreme density to unparalleled levels.

data centers. The first SUPERNAP^{®} data center, designed in 2006 by Rob Roy, was an air & liquid
cooling hybrid design built decades before the AI revolution. Rob Roy’s new EVO AI Factories design
has now taken extreme density to unparalleled levels.

Our 150-member strong engineering team offers Product Engineering, Prototype Manufacturing and

12 World Class Manufacturing Facilities with Automation & Vertical Integration. Large Greenfield
Campuses in work.

#### The Graduate Engineer Trainee Program

A key leadership pipeline development program, this program aims to attract and develop graduate
trainees to take on leadership positions within the organization

#### Lean Manufacturing Workshops

and cost through process improvements

#### Diversified workforce leveraging Women Power

Our team of ~9000 employees comprises about 48% women employees. Diversity is a key strength that
powers us.

We continuously invest in our teams on both functional and leadership development

FrameworX AI Designer connects AI directly to the live Designer IDE through 18 specialized MCP

Built on 100% managed .NET code. No legacy constraints. No bolt-on architecture.

18 specialized MCP tools give AI full access to the FrameworX Designer IDE. Describe your tags,
alarms, historian, device protocols, displays, and scripts. AI creates everything in real time
inside the live development environment. Every change is visible as it happens.

OPC-UA, Modbus, BACnet, MQTT with SparkplugB, Siemens S7, Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, and dozens
more. Every connector ships with every license. Built-in MQTT broker and native Unified Namespace
keep data structured from the PLC to every consuming system. One Designer environment for all
modules. WebAssembly deployment runs on desktop, web, and mobile without plugins.

Devices, Alarms, Historian, Reports, Scripts, Datasets, Security, and DevOps tools ship with every
license. No add-on modules to buy, no feature restrictions,

## Políticas de ESG

##### Compromisso com um futuro sustentável

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

Na Tecto Data Centers, acreditamos que o futuro da infraestrutura digital precisa crescer de forma
responsável. Nosso compromisso com ESG está conectado à forma como projetamos, operamos e expandimos
nossos data centers na América Latina, priorizando eficiência energética, uso de energia renovável,
inovação operacional e impacto positivo nas comunidades onde atuamos.

Como uma plataforma especializada em soluções de colocation de alta performance, conectividade e
serviços gerenciados, trabalhamos para entregar infraestrutura preparada para o crescimento digital
e para as demandas de IA, sem renunciar à sustentabilidade e da responsabilidade com o futuro.

##### Operamos com Energia 100% Renovável e Certificada

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

A eficiência energética está no centro do nosso modelo operacional. Nossos data centers são
projetados para operar com baixo PUE e alto desempenho, combinando engenharia avançada com gestão
contínua de consumo. Além disso, 100% da energia utilizada é proveniente de fontes renováveis,
certificada pelo I-REC, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma operação eficiente, escalável e
alinhada às exigências de clientes e investidores globais. 

##### Sistema de Gestão Ambiental

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

Desenvolvemos um Sistema de Gestão Ambiental que atua de ponta a ponta na cadeia de valor, desde a
prospecção e licenciamento até a operação dos data centers. O sistema integra processos, controles e
monitoramento contínuo, assegurando conformidade regulatória, gestão eficiente de recursos e
evolução constante da performance ambiental. Mais do que um requisito, trata-se de um instrumento de
gestão que sustenta a expansão da companhia com segurança e consistência.

##### Relacionamento com a Comunidade Local

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

A Tecto mantém uma gestão ativa e responsável do relacionamento com as comunidades locais, baseada
no respeito às características culturais e no diálogo transparente. Buscamos antecipar impactos,
mitigar riscos e potencializar benefícios, fortalecendo a integração dos nossos projetos com o
entorno. Essa abordagem contribui para a sustentabilidade dos empreendimentos e para a construção de
relações duradouras e positivas.
