## Políticas de ESG

##### Compromisso com um futuro sustentável

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

Na Tecto Data Centers, acreditamos que o futuro da infraestrutura digital precisa crescer de forma
responsável. Nosso compromisso com ESG está conectado à forma como projetamos, operamos e expandimos
nossos data centers na América Latina, priorizando eficiência energética, uso de energia renovável,
inovação operacional e impacto positivo nas comunidades onde atuamos.

Como uma plataforma especializada em soluções de colocation de alta performance, conectividade e
serviços gerenciados, trabalhamos para entregar infraestrutura preparada para o crescimento digital
e para as demandas de IA, sem renunciar à sustentabilidade e da responsabilidade com o futuro.

##### Operamos com Energia 100% Renovável e Certificada

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

A eficiência energética está no centro do nosso modelo operacional. Nossos data centers são
projetados para operar com baixo PUE e alto desempenho, combinando engenharia avançada com gestão
contínua de consumo. Além disso, 100% da energia utilizada é proveniente de fontes renováveis,
certificada pelo I-REC, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma operação eficiente, escalável e
alinhada às exigências de clientes e investidores globais. 

##### Sistema de Gestão Ambiental

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

Desenvolvemos um Sistema de Gestão Ambiental que atua de ponta a ponta na cadeia de valor, desde a
prospecção e licenciamento até a operação dos data centers. O sistema integra processos, controles e
monitoramento contínuo, assegurando conformidade regulatória, gestão eficiente de recursos e
evolução constante da performance ambiental. Mais do que um requisito, trata-se de um instrumento de
gestão que sustenta a expansão da companhia com segurança e consistência.

##### Relacionamento com a Comunidade Local

[quadrado-verde-12x12]

A Tecto mantém uma gestão ativa e responsável do relacionamento com as comunidades locais, baseada
no respeito às características culturais e no diálogo transparente. Buscamos antecipar impactos,
mitigar riscos e potencializar benefícios, fortalecendo a integração dos nossos projetos com o
entorno. Essa abordagem contribui para a sustentabilidade dos empreendimentos e para a construção de
relações duradouras e positivas.

# On-device Generative Vision AI. Private. Personalized. Always on.

We create on-device AI solutions that transform everyday experiences, from private personal
assistants and real-time vision apps to life-enhancing health tools and personalized creative
engines. Our mission is to help build AI that’s fast, private, and trusted — redefining how people
interact with technology.

[Privacy-First AI Apps][7]

## AI Services

### Health & Wellness AI

Health is one of the most sensitive data domains — and also one of the most promising for on-device
AI. Phones are already packed with sensors: accelerometers, gyroscopes, microphones, cameras, and
sometimes even ECG or blood oxygen sensors. On-device AI can process all of this locally to detect
patterns in breathing, heart rate, sleep cycles, or posture, without ever sending data to third
parties.

This unlocks powerful new use cases. Think of a phone that can detect arrhythmia just by analyzing
subtle variations in your heartbeat through a camera flash. Even diabetes management could benefit
as AI could easily analyze daily photos of the food intake to monitor the nutrition and calories
consumed periodically, monitoring trends and making helpful suggestions for healthy consumption.

### Real-Time Vision & AR

Smartphones are already our second set of eyes — cameras, sensors, AR. On-device AI supercharges
this by enabling real-time perception without the lag of cloud processing. Point your camera at an
object, and instantly get product info, nutritional breakdowns, or repair instructions. Hold your
phone up to a street sign in Tokyo and see it translated into English in milliseconds.

This is also a huge leap for accessibility. For visually impaired users, real-time object
recognition and scene description can turn the phone into a guide that narrates the environment,
with no internet required. For travelers, it means never feeling lost in a new country. For
shoppers, it’s instant price comparison and “scan to buy” capabilities right in the store aisle.

### Creative Media Tools

Generative AI is already transforming creativity, but most tools today are cloud-based and generic.
On-device AI changes that by putting powerful creative engines directly in the user’s pocket. Want
to enhance a photo, remix a song, or draft a journal entry? Your phone can do it instantly, without
uploading sensitive content to a remote server.

The personalization angle here is huge. A generative model fine-tuned locally can learn your writing
voice, your photography style, or your music taste. It can become a kind of co-creator that knows
what you like, not what some global dataset assumes. A student could have their own private AI tutor
that remembers their learning history. A content creator could have a video-editing assistant that
anticipates their editing style.

human-centric, from health monitoring and real-time vision to creative tools. We help companies
build AI that users can trust, unlocking new opportunities for growth and innovation.

thinkers with deep expertise in edge AI, mobile optimization, and model deployment. We specialize in

# On-device Generative Vision AI. Private. Personalized. Always on.

We create on-device AI solutions that transform everyday experiences, from private personal
assistants and real-time vision apps to life-enhancing health tools and personalized creative
engines. Our mission is to help build AI that’s fast, private, and trusted — redefining how people
interact with technology.

[Privacy-First AI Apps][7]

## AI Services

### Health & Wellness AI

Health is one of the most sensitive data domains — and also one of the most promising for on-device
AI. Phones are already packed with sensors: accelerometers, gyroscopes, microphones, cameras, and
sometimes even ECG or blood oxygen sensors. On-device AI can process all of this locally to detect
patterns in breathing, heart rate, sleep cycles, or posture, without ever sending data to third
parties.

This unlocks powerful new use cases. Think of a phone that can detect arrhythmia just by analyzing
subtle variations in your heartbeat through a camera flash. Even diabetes management could benefit
as AI could easily analyze daily photos of the food intake to monitor the nutrition and calories
consumed periodically, monitoring trends and making helpful suggestions for healthy consumption.

### Real-Time Vision & AR

Smartphones are already our second set of eyes — cameras, sensors, AR. On-device AI supercharges
this by enabling real-time perception without the lag of cloud processing. Point your camera at an
object, and instantly get product info, nutritional breakdowns, or repair instructions. Hold your
phone up to a street sign in Tokyo and see it translated into English in milliseconds.

This is also a huge leap for accessibility. For visually impaired users, real-time object
recognition and scene description can turn the phone into a guide that narrates the environment,
with no internet required. For travelers, it means never feeling lost in a new country. For
shoppers, it’s instant price comparison and “scan to buy” capabilities right in the store aisle.

### Creative Media Tools

Generative AI is already transforming creativity, but most tools today are cloud-based and generic.
On-device AI changes that by putting powerful creative engines directly in the user’s pocket. Want
to enhance a photo, remix a song, or draft a journal entry? Your phone can do it instantly, without
uploading sensitive content to a remote server.

The personalization angle here is huge. A generative model fine-tuned locally can learn your writing
voice, your photography style, or your music taste. It can become a kind of co-creator that knows
what you like, not what some global dataset assumes. A student could have their own private AI tutor
that remembers their learning history. A content creator could have a video-editing assistant that
anticipates their editing style.

#### Leading Data Centers for Managed Hosting & Cloud

Fastest access to your data is the key to keep your business running perfectly. Web Werks is the
most trusted data center provider in India, offering global presence, leading technologies and
comprehensive data center solutions to meet your IT infrastructure requirements. As one of the
leading data center providers in the world, we promote innovation combined with exceptional security
to deliver services that truly make a difference in the way you do business. Choose the space,
power, and connections you need from our range of colocation services including wholesale and retail
colocation, smart hands, and more.

## Why Choose Web Werks

[Co-Location]

### Global Data Center
### Locations

We deliver managed hosting and multicloud hybrid IT solutions in 19+ state-of-the-art data centers
across India, USA, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Colocate your IT and network systems in a secure,
connected, and high-performance environment.

[Co-Location]

### Secure, Reliable & Agile Infrastructure

Our data centers meet your requirements for scalability, customizable high-density power, cooling
containment, physical security, and high availability.

### Services Leader

direct connectivity to all major network service providers and internet exchanges for best
application performance & user experience.
